plan_status: Post-hoc forensic analysis plan, not prospective preregistration of an independent experiment; filename follows historical repository convention
scope: Post-hoc CPU checkpoint audit and direct linearized readout fits; no new stochastic training, no selection or release
direct_fit: One weighted linearized ridge least-squares solve in the SAME existing frozen feature space. A=features*sigmoid_derivative; rhs=teacher_probability-baseline_probability; lambda=relative_ridge*largest_singular_value. Fit on original41p training anchors only; report each ridge and both arm scopes on independent anchors. Materialize float32 weights; no new model chosen.
analyses: Compute full fixed training objective for baseline and every checkpoint, not sampled log minibatches
Measure actual materialized coefficient errors on fit and independent anchors
Measure surrogate versus materialized logit gap
Compare coefficient/current errors at archived reference offset crossings and actual timing errors
SVD effective ranks, parameter displacement and actual float32 direct-fit errors
Post-hoc extension: analytic per-input lower bound for training objective with nontrainable update fractions fixed, distinguishing frozen-rate error from useful optimization progress

hypotheses.objective: Lower original full training loss can coincide with worse crossing coefficients and archived timing, indicating objective/support mismatch.
hypotheses.optimizer: A deterministic same-feature direct fit can improve held-out coefficient errors beyond Adam checkpoints, indicating unused room within tested heads (not proof that timing passes).
hypotheses.representation: Failure of these local linearized fits is inconclusive about full architecture capacity; ill conditioning, quantization and nonlinear objective remain alternatives.
hypotheses.materialization: Surrogate precision/rounding can separate training predictions from actual materialized network; quantify this gap rather than assuming equivalence.

limits: No GPU or fresh full training allocated
Opened diagnostic panels do not constitute independent confirmation
Direct fits are diagnostic only, never silently selected
No thresholds, baseline weights or abstraction changed
A failed local linearized solve cannot prove representation impossibility
